card.name: Missed doses and timing words
card.fires_on: Words about forgetting or remembering a dose (forget, remembered) and timing words like next dose or timer, mostly in missed-dose instructions.

modes.label: Forgetting or remembering
modes.description: The verb forget or remember in instructions for a missed tablet.
modes.example: If the patient<< forget>>s to take one or more tablets,

modes.label: Next dose or timer
modes.description: The word dose or time after 'next' or 'later', or a timer device.
modes.example: If it is almost time for the next<< dose>>, the patient should skip the missed dose

card.writes: It pushes toward schedule-related words such as Schedule and scheduled.
card.plain: It lights up when the text talks about missing, forgetting or timing a dose.
